thread:
maya: Heads up — prepping a Q3 slice of the roadmap for enterprise certification (SOC2 / ISO) + BYOK/KMS asks. Need to align scope and launch gates for: audit logs retention, KMS handshake/rotation, evidence export SLA, legal-hold. Customers asking for 7y retention + per-tenant key escrow. Quick thoughts?

arjun: Can we separate concerns? Suggest phased approach: BYOK handshake + rotation first, then retention tiering and evidence export in later phases.

li: Security POV: per-tenant CMKs + optional HSM escrow covers compliance but increases threat surface & support burden. If we accept 7y retention we need explicit key-rotation docs and immutable audit. Storage cost estimate will jump ~+40%.

sarah: Legal: 7y retention is heavy but some finserv/regulatory customers ask. We require legal-hold escape hatch, clear chain-of-custody, and documented export format for e-discovery.

maya: Proposed phased launch gates: 1) BYOK handshake + rotation + audit-log V1 (30d retention default) + acceptance tests; 2) retention tiering + legal-hold + retention SLAs; 3) long-term evidence export (7y cold storage + export tooling). Agree?

arjun: Agree with phases. Engineering notes: need precise export format (NDJSON with event schema), size/SLA limits, and cost-recovery plan for cold storage. Implementation plan: short-term (90d), mid-tier (1y warm), long-term (7y cold).

jamie: Ops/SRE: Tiering needs lifecycle policies in object store, restore runbooks, and retention-rollback playbook. Ops estimate: +1 eng oncall FTE for first 6 months and automation to avoid manual restores.

maya: Customers that pushed this: @acme, @ledger. They want BYOK + 7y retention. We should capture these as customer-driven acceptance criteria in the PRD. Who picks up keystore spec ownership?

li: I'll own the KMS handshake threat model and handshake spec (includes attestation, signatures, rotation choreography). Need product decisions on: escrow vs. non-escrow mandatory, manual vs. automated rotation window.

sarah: I'll draft legalhold acceptance criteria + required evidence packaging for e-discovery. Need to confirm regulatory differences by region (EU vs US).

arjun: I'll do a rough eng effort estimate in sprint planning: pairing task list (handshake API, key storage adapter, rotation controller, audit plumbing, export pipeline). Also call out fallback policy: what happens if customer's key becomes unavailable?

sarah: Fallback must be explicit opt-in. Automatic fallback to hosted keys without customer consent is a legal risk. Must document consent flow and SLA implications.

maya: Action items: maya - PRD section by EOD Friday; li - handshake spec by next Wed; arjun - sprint effort estimate in planning by next Tue; jamie - ops runbook stub + lifecycle policy by next Thu. Anyone else?

arjun: I'll include runbook hooks in the estimate. Also include canary + A/B on rollback behavior.

jamie: Ops will prototype lifecycle policies in staging next week and measure restore times/cost.

maya: Quick poll: are we comfortable shipping BYOK MVP without 7y retention? React with :+1: = ship MVP without 7y, :eyes: = needs discussion, :-1: = don't ship without full retention.

li: :+1: ship MVP without long-term retention, security ok as long as audit and rotation are solid.

arjun: :eyes: want confirmation on export size/SLA before committing to reduced scope.

sarah: :-1: need legalhold behavior defined before any BYOK rollout to paying customers in regulated sectors.

calendar-bot: Scheduled a follow-up: "Compliance scope sync" — Wed 10:00 — product room.

maya: Thanks all — I'll post the PRD link after the EOD write-up and share the meeting invite. We'll use the follow-up to finalize gates + acceptance criteria.
